name: Uchiyomi
subtitle: Your manga library, available offline.
localizedDescription: An experimental native iPhone and iPad client for your own compatible Uchiyomi server. Connect over HTTPS, sign in, and download chapters for offline reading. Requires a server with mobile-assets.json support; older upstream servers need the compatible frontend changes. Build an unsigned IPA and install it through AltStore Classic. Basic iPhone operation has been owner-tested; extended device and update acceptance remains in progress.
